description: Add comprehensive user-facing documentation under docs/: docs/cli.md (complete CLI reference for both binaries, including the podman group with Fix 1's new -restart-always/marker semantics and Fix 2's -h behavior) and docs/user-guide.md (user-facing guide to grimoire: what it is, architecture, how to run, admin, REST surface, permalinks/archives, themes, known gaps). Cross-link both from README.md and reconcile docs/podman-dev-stack.md with the two fixes. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (docs must reflect the shipped flag/behavior).
steps: Create docs/cli.md matching the tone of docs/compatibility.md. (a) `grimoire` server: real flags only — `-config` (default configs/grimoire.sqlite.yaml) and `-themes` (default themes); GRIMOIRE_* env overrides from internal/config/config.go (GRIMOIRE_SERVER_ADDR, GRIMOIRE_THEME, GRIMOIRE_DATABASE_VENDOR, GRIMOIRE_DATABASE_DSN, GRIMOIRE_DATABASE_TABLE_PREFIX, GRIMOIRE_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME/COOKIE_SECURE/TTL_HOURS, GRIMOIRE_REST_REQUIRE_TLS_FOR_APPLICATION_PASSWORDS/TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADER/PER_PAGE_MAX, GRIMOIRE_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS); config resolution order file -> env -> defaults. (b) `grimoire-cli`: each subcommand with purpose, flags, env, realistic examples — `migrate` three modes (default greenfield; -overlay additive WordPress adoption; -check read-only preflight) with WHEN-to-use-each and the 'never run bare migrate against a populated WordPress DB' warning (greenfield uses ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN and fails/corrupts a real WP DB; -overlay is IF NOT EXISTS only, no ALTER TABLE); all share -config (default configs/grimoire.sqlite.yaml). `seed`. `createadmin` (-login, -email required; -password or GRIMOIRE_ADMIN_PASSWORD env; -display-name; refuses to overwrite an existing login). `sessions gc`. The full `podman` group (up/down/status/build/autostart install|uninstall): summarize and LINK to docs/podman-dev-stack.md, but DO include the full flag table (-table-prefix, -grimoire-port, -wordpress-port, -network, -image, -mysql-image, -wordpress-image, -db-name, -db-user, -uploads-mount, -machine, up's -restart-always, build's -context) and GRIMOIRE_PODMAN_* env overrides (GRIMOIRE_PODMAN_TABLE_PREFIX/NETWORK/IMAGE/MACHINE/GRIMOIRE_PORT/WORDPRESS_PORT; precedence flag > env > default) and the autostart behavior INCLUDING Fix 1's new semantics (restart lost on recreate is fixed; autostart install writes a marker; up auto-reapplies --restart always when the marker/plist is present; up -restart-always forces it) and Fix 2's -h behavior. (c) 'Common workflows' section: SQLite dev loop; adopting an existing WordPress DB via -overlay (run -check first; set media.uploads_dir); the local podman stack.

Create docs/user-guide.md (chosen over overview.md as the clearer name). Sections: what grimoire is (Go-native, WordPress-schema-compatible CMS, no PHP, swappable DB); architecture at a readable level (ports & adapters: internal/domain core + repository ports, storage adapters sqlite/mysql/postgres, internal/render + themes, internal/web — from README's Architecture and Repository layout); how to run against SQLite and against an existing WordPress DB (link to docs/cli.md for exact commands; include the media.uploads_dir caveat from README/config: grimoire reads media rows but serves files from disk, so point uploads_dir at the real wp-content/uploads or images 404); the embedded Adobe React Spectrum admin; the WordPress-compatible REST API surface at /wp-json/wp/v2/* and Application Passwords auth; permalinks/archives behavior (M9a tokens %postname%/%post_id%/%year%/%monthnum%/%day%, 301 canonical redirects, unsupported-structure fallback+warn; M9b nested category/tag/author/date archives, category_base/tag_base, ?page=N pagination divergence; grimoire applies permalink structure to pages too, a known divergence); themes; known gaps (REST DELETE on media/users returns 501 while create/update shipped in M10.B/M10.C; only category and post_tag taxonomies and only `post` archives; read-only term hierarchy). Accurate to M1–M10 complete; do not overclaim. Pull specifics from README.md, docs/compatibility.md, docs/wordpress-compatibility-tour.md; link rather than restate; do NOT contradict them.

Update README.md: add docs/cli.md and docs/user-guide.md to the docs list in the intro (near the existing links to docs/compatibility.md and docs/wordpress-compatibility-tour.md) and reference them from the Running section; keep README concise (link, do not duplicate the new content).

Update docs/podman-dev-stack.md: in the 'macOS autostart' section add that the former lost-on-recreate behavior is fixed — autostart install writes a marker file, `up` auto-reapplies `--restart always` when the marker (or the LaunchAgent plist) is present, and `up -restart-always` forces the policy without autostart configured; add `-restart-always` to the Configuration flag table and mention it on the `up` subcommand bullet. Note Fix 2: `autostart -h` and a bare `autostart` now print help and exit 0. Keep the licensing note and existing structure.

Ensure NO private tooling paths appear in any doc (do not reference the external private podman stack scripts or any private runbook). The `accuweaver` table-prefix discussion is fine (it is the public default).
acceptance_criteria: docs/cli.md and docs/user-guide.md exist and read consistently with docs/compatibility.md tone.
Every flag named in docs/cli.md actually exists in cmd/grimoire (only -config, -themes) and cmd/grimoire-cli source (migrate/seed/createadmin/sessions/podman) — no invented flags.
Every GRIMOIRE_* and GRIMOIRE_PODMAN_* env var named matches internal/config/config.go and podman_config.go exactly.

docs/cli.md documents the podman group with the full flag table, GRIMOIRE_PODMAN_* precedence, Fix 1's -restart-always + marker auto-reapply, and Fix 2's -h behavior, and links to docs/podman-dev-stack.md.
docs/user-guide.md's claims do not contradict README.md or docs/compatibility.md (known gaps: REST deletes 501, only category/post_tag + post archives, read-only term hierarchy).
README.md links to both new docs from the intro docs list and the Running section.
docs/podman-dev-stack.md's autostart section reflects Fix 1 and Fix 2; -restart-always is in its flag table.
No private tooling paths in any doc.
verification: grep -rn 'private-podman-stack-scripts' docs/ README.md ; echo 'expect: no private-path matches'

for f in -config -themes -overlay -check -restart-always -table-prefix -grimoire-port -wordpress-port -network -image -uploads-mount -machine -context; do grep -rqn -- "$f" cmd/ || echo "MISSING FLAG IN CODE: $f"; done
findings:
Done. Created docs/cli.md and docs/user-guide.md, cross-linked both from README.md (intro docs list + Running section), and reconciled docs/podman-dev-stack.md with Fix 1 and Fix 2.

Key facts / verification:
- `go build ./...` passes (docs-only change; build confirmed green from the worktree).
- All flags/env vars were cross-checked against source before writing. Server (cmd/grimoire/main.go) has ONLY -config (default configs/grimoire.sqlite.yaml) and -themes (default themes). GRIMOIRE_* env overrides and the file->env->defaults resolution are documented exactly per internal/config/config.go (incl. the require_tls_for_application_passwords default-true quirk). grimoire-cli subcommands documented from cmd/grimoire-cli/main.go: migrate (-config/-overlay/-check, mutually exclusive -overlay/-check, never-run-bare-migrate warning), seed (-config), createadmin (-config/-login/-email/-password/-display-name + GRIMOIRE_ADMIN_PASSWORD, refuses to overwrite existing login), sessions gc (-config). podman group documented from podman_config.go/podman.go/podman_argv.go/podman_autostart.go: full flag table (-table-prefix,-grimoire-port,-wordpress-port,-network,-image,-mysql-image,-wordpress-image,-db-name,-db-user,-uploads-mount,-machine, up's -restart-always, build's -context) and the six GRIMOIRE_PODMAN_* env vars (TABLE_PREFIX/NETWORK/IMAGE/MACHINE/GRIMOIRE_PORT/WORDPRESS_PORT) with precedence flag > env > default.
- Fix 1 documented in both docs/cli.md and docs/podman-dev-stack.md: -restart-always sets --restart always on the three stack containers at create time; up auto-reapplies it when the marker (~/.local/share/grimoire/podman-autostart, written by autostart install) or the LaunchAgent plist is present; policy no longer silently lost on recreate. Fix 2 documented: bare `autostart` and `autostart -h`/--help/help print usage and exit 0; install/uninstall -h exit 0; unknown action still errors.
- docs/cli.md links to docs/podman-dev-stack.md; docs/user-guide.md links to compatibility.md, wordpress-compatibility-tour.md, cli.md, README.md.
- user-guide.md known gaps match README/compatibility: REST DELETE on media/users returns 501 (create/update shipped M10.B/M10.C), only category/post_tag taxonomies and only `post` archives, read-only term hierarchy; plus permalink-on-pages and ?page=N archive pagination divergences; media.uploads_dir caveat included.
- No private tooling paths in any doc I created or edited (grep of docs/cli.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/podman-dev-stack.md, README.md for the external private podman stack scripts returns nothing). NOTE: a pre-existing reference to the external private podman stack scripts remains in docs/compatibility.md (line ~329), which is outside FEAT-003's scope and was not touched. The public 'accuweaver' table-prefix default is used where appropriate and is fine.
- Verification note: the feature's flag-existence grep loop searches cmd/ for dash-prefixed forms (e.g. '-themes'), which yields false 'MISSING' lines because the Go flag names are string literals without the dash ('themes','wordpress-port','uploads-mount'); grepping for the quoted literal form confirms every documented flag exists in code.
